about: Provenance for every model in site/assets/props/. Licence rule for this set: CC0, Fab Standard or Quaternius QAL only, checked per asset.

conventions.pivot: on the ground at the base of the object (y = 0). Exceptions, all deliberate: boats pivot at the WATERLINE so the hull sits below y = 0; pier_* put the walking surface at y = 0 with the piles hanging to about y = -2.3 so deck runs stay level over water; lighthouse, watchtower, stilt_hut and some ruins dip a little below 0 where a rock footing, pile or fallen block is meant to bed into the ground.
conventions.shading: flat, vertex colours only (COLOR_0), no textures, one material per model

packs_evaluated_not_used.name: Kenney Pirate Kit
packs_evaluated_not_used.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
packs_evaluated_not_used.why_not: its ships are square-rigged galleons and its models are mapped to a shared colormap texture; the key art's boat is an open clinker longboat and this set is vertex-colour only

packs_evaluated_not_used.name: Kenney Castle Kit
packs_evaluated_not_used.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
packs_evaluated_not_used.why_not: fortress walls and siege engines, not the Mediterranean harbour town and weathered watchtower the reference painting shows; also texture-atlas based
